reason: The LAN endpoint's pin (E-3b): the Gateway advertises this value with its endpoints, and the phone compares the certificate the LAN leg serves against it. Both implementations must derive it identically - standard base64 of SHA-256 over the certificate's public key as the raw uncompressed X9.63 point (0x04 || X || Y) - or a paired phone can never admit the LAN leg. The Gateway test (lan-endpoint.integration.test.ts) and the phone test (GatewayProtocolContractTests.swift) both assert their own implementation against this certificate.
